recommendations.title: Refresh: Consolidated "Bästa hembatteri 2026" buyer's guide
recommendations.details: Combine existing comparison text, technical details and the service recommendation into one buyer-focused article titled "Bästa hembatteri 2026 — köpguide." Start with a short ranked list of recommended models (Easyway, Eway, SAJ HS3, Enershare, SigenStor) and one-sentence buyer profiles (when each is best). Add a pros/cons bullet for each model, a short explanation of how to choose (capacity, inverter compatibility, modularity, chemistry), and finish with 3–4 common household scenarios with explicit model recommendations.
suggestedSections: Kortfattad topp-5: vem passar vilken modell?
Snabb jämförelsetabell: kapacitet, modularitet, inverter, garanti, verkningsgrad
Hur du väljer: budget, kWh-behov, effekt/power, backup vs ekonomi
Vanliga scenarier och rekommendationer (villa med sol, småhus utan sol, EV-ägare, önskad backup)

recommendations.title: CREATE: Price & total-installed-cost comparison article
recommendations.details: Publish the promised price analysis showing typical installed costs for each recommended battery (hardware, inverter if needed, installation, and Optimera Energi's transparent margins). Include example quotes for common system sizes (e.g., 5 kWh, 10 kWh, 15 kWh) and note eligibility for grönt avdrag / Villaeffekten where relevant. Provide simple payback examples with and without revenue from support services.
suggestedSections: Varför priset varierar: hårdvara, växelriktare, installation
Bidrag, avdrag och skatteeffekter (grönt avdrag, Villaeffekten)
Tips för att få en rättvis offert

recommendations.title: Refresh: Spec sheet table on the technical comparison page
recommendations.details: Add a clear, visual spec table to the technical comparison page (Hembatterier 2026: så är de byggda) that lists for each model: usable kWh per module/unit, expandable steps, inverter type (inbuilt vs external), max stack size, chemistry, round-trip efficiency, warranty length and typical power (kW). This makes technical differences immediately scannable for buyers.
suggestedSections: Vad varje rad betyder (kort förklaring av usable kWh, round-trip efficiency, mm)
Källor och datum för varje siffra
